record.title: Signed small ball conjecture
record.statement:
Does the signed small ball lower bound
\[
\left\|\sum_{|R|=2^{-n}}\alpha_R h_R\right\|_{L^\infty([0,1]^d)}\gtrsim n^{d/2}
\]
hold for every \(n\), every choice of signs \(\alpha_R\in\{-1,1\}\), and every dimension \(d\ge 3\), where \(R\) ranges over dyadic rectangles in \([0,1]^d\) and \(h_R\) is the corresponding \(L^\infty\)-normalized Haar function?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2013/49](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/12723), page 9. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

\]

record.title: Higher additive divisor problem
record.statement:
For every integer $r\ge 3$ and every fixed nonzero integer $h$, let
$$
D_r(X;h):=\sum_{n\le X} d_r(n)d_r(n+h),
$$
where $d_r(n)$ is the number of representations of $n$ as a product of $r$ positive integers. It is conjectured that, as $X\to\infty$,
$$
D_r(X;h)\sim X P_{2(r-1)}(\log X;h),
$$
where $P_{2(r-1)}(u;h)$ is a polynomial in $u$ of degree $2(r-1)$ whose coefficients depend on $h$ and $r$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2013/51](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/12725), page 58. Canonicalized from 3 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Read’s conjecture on log-concavity of chromatic-polynomial coefficients
record.statement:
For a finite graph $G$, let its chromatic polynomial be written as
\[
\chi_q(G)=a_nq^n-a_{n-1}q^{n-1}+\cdots+(-1)^na_0.
\]
Then the sequence $a_0,a_1,\ldots,a_n$ is log-concave; that is, for every integer $i$ with $0<i<n$,
\[
a_{i-1}a_{i+1}\le a_i^2.
\]

record.title: Expected length of the longest $k$-alternating subsequence
record.statement:
For each permutation $w\in S_n$, let $\operatorname{as}_k(w)$ be the length of the longest sequence $w_{i_1}>w_{i_2}<w_{i_3}>w_{i_4}<\cdots$ such that $|w_{i_j}-w_{i_{j+1}}|\ge k$ for every $j$. Define
\[
\operatorname{as}_k(n):=\frac{1}{n!}\sum_{w\in S_n}\operatorname{as}_k(w).
\]
The conjecture is that, for $1\le k\le n-1$,
\[
\operatorname{as}_k(n)=\frac{4(n-k)+1}{6}.
\]

$$
\|r(A)\|\le 2\sup_{z\in W(A)}|r(z)|.

record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2014/20](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/12978), page 22. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Characters over the origin for multiplier algebras of properly embedded discs
record.statement: Let $f:\mathbb D\to V\subset\mathbb B_\infty$ be a proper embedding that extends continuously to $\overline{\mathbb D}$, and assume that $f(0)=0$. Is the character of point evaluation at $0$ the only character $\rho$ on $\mathcal M_V$ such that $\rho(Z_i)=0$ for every coordinate index $i$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2014/21](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/12979), page 30. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.
